"fr81-u102-r0021", "tag": "prose", "text": "C’était l’accent de Castlereagh rédigeant au Congrès de Vienne la carte à payer de la France.", "sha256": "f4e6d873fab1330370b63be11720baceba676d67a432511aabaad796a39936f9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0022", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Monsieur Thénardier, tu as raison, il doit bien cela, murmura la femme qui songeait à la poupée donnée à Cosette en présence de ses filles, c’est juste, mais c’est trop. Il ne voudra pas payer.", "sha256": "858a5d7856e1cffbb22fa05d2f2319779ca075e95a2e8d0affe04b943edc636c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0023", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le Thénardier fit son rire froid, et dit :", "sha256": "90af7329b08faa6e80a87c18d86b3380b54f4003670ea19544b1a2f18bd0c3f2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0024", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il payera.", "sha256": "388eae729e6497bc30fe41eac90f4ba4d8bae58094b57a83d291a4cd822295bc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0025", "tag": "prose", "text": "Ce rire était la signification suprême de la certitude et de l’autorité. Ce qui était dit ainsi devait être. La femme n’insista point. Elle se mit à ranger les tables ; le mari marchait de long en large dans la salle. Un moment après il ajouta :", "sha256": "fc826f6fa17554d4c239cf26492aab4eaff57168798467ebb00fb67052a6881a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0026", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je dois bien quinze cents francs, moi !", "sha256": "4256ee34e9af6e53243295e46e519683dbbd178d1c4ca9d8fba1ca79d887697d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0027", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il alla s’asseoir au coin de la cheminée, méditant, les pieds sur les cendres chaudes.", "sha256": "9761ea7d6f96582438640f2a159cbecba79d15eccf0440bafb7258a52d5c0509", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0028", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah çà ! reprit la femme, tu n’oublies pas que je flanque Cosette à la porte aujourd’hui ? Ce monstre ! elle me mange le cœur avec sa poupée ! J’aimerais mieux épouser Louis XVIII que de la garder un jour de plus à la maison !", "sha256": "2ca8edfc677acd31f420eb2aba77f185f1005ffddbe82ada00733752d65ba1a0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0029", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le Thénardier alluma sa pipe et répondit entre deux bouffées :", "sha256": "00373d866b4288889bafeff05423ef0cab6ba1169c165061c0d89de9cef0673a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0030", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tu remettras la carte à l’homme.", "sha256": "4c8ba3686236750b91015dcb5695f397c4b8e63512b39434e93c7af742b2f7e8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0031", "tag": "prose", "text": "Puis il sortit.", "sha256": "dbe98660fe60537e946f732c5e9ed4d23c942c8dabc18315b71a1065e2263124", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}], "format_retry_instruction": "Previous response failed strict validation: AssertionError: EMPHASIS_MARKER_COUNT.
